home.title: Get set up without the guesswork
home.body:
Start with **Requirements**, then follow the **Setup guide** step by step. Stuck on an error? Search the code in **Error fixes**.

This app updates itself. When something changes you will see it here, no reinstall needed.

tabs.description: Check all of this before you install anything.

tabs.name: Setup guide
tabs.description: Step by step, start to finish. Takes about 10 minutes.

blocks.title: Helios Setup
blocks.intro: Do these in order. Don't skip ahead.

steps.title: Download the latest files
steps.body:
Go to Input Sense and find the Resources Channel 

- Click Get the latest Helios version here 
- Make sure to Extract All

steps.title: Once you open Helios
steps.body: Tools > Preferences > Account > Make sure you sign into your Discord account you'll be buying the Subscription on.

steps.title: Capture Card
steps.body:
Look at the Pictures Below to setup your Capture Card 

(Head over to [How to Fix Meter Not Reading](#go/errors/b8/e%3AMeter%20Not%20Reading) for the Console Settings you'll need to put on before plugging in your Capture Card

steps.title: Remote Play
steps.body: Watch the video below on how to setup Remote Play

steps.title: Titan Setup
steps.body: Look at the Pictures Below to setup your Titan 2

steps.title: Makcu
steps.body: Look at the Pictures Below to setup your Makcu

steps.title: Python
steps.body:
Once you setup your Remote Play, Titan or Makcu now you'll need to install InputSense-CUDA. 

Go to Online Resources and download Input Sense CUDA

(Note it make take a few minutes to install and that is normal please be patient)

steps.title: Script
steps.body:
Depending on what game you want to play download the script that you want to use. 

(Note MLB and CFB have extra payments)
- 2k Vision
- Aim Engine 
- MLB Vision 
- CFB Vision

steps.title: ID
steps.body: do /get in any Channel in Input Sense and click Login ID to get your ID

steps.title: Meter
steps.body:
Late - Go up 
Early - Go down 

**Tempo**
Fast - Go down 
Slow - Go up

steps.title: Skele
steps.body:
**Requirements For Skele**
- Nvidia Gpu 3050 or better 

- Online Resources > Download Skele 
- Tools > Engine Builder > Click Skele > Click Build > If you have a high end Gpu build it on FP32 if not do FP16 but we still recommend FP16 since Skele is a big weight. 

On 2k Vision if think your Skele isn't working click *Model* on the right side and select Skele

(Note AMD can be supported but don't except amazing results)

steps.title: Weights
steps.body:
You'll need to buy a Weight from a creator to be able to use Aim Engine, Head over to[Weights](#go/community) and Join a server to buy a Weight

(If you don't want to buy a Weight in Online Resources search the game you want to play and see if there's any free Weights)

steps.title: Building Weights
steps.body:
Once you bought a Weight do this 
- Tools > Engine Builder > Click The Weight > Click Build > Build it on FP32

steps.body: If you need your settings done please contact

tabs.name: Error Code/Fixes
tabs.description: Most Error Codes have the same fix so if you don't see your Error Code on here try the most common fix

items.title: CV Python Error
items.fix:
Delete Bin Folder
Reinstall InputSense-CUDA From Online Resources 
Only if the First And Second fix don't work try this (Video Below)

items.title: Remote Play doesn't seem to connect try this
items.cause: Connection Issues, USB to Ethernet Adapter has gone bad.
items.fix:
Turn off ur playstation
Stop ur connection sharing on pc
Turn ps on
Reshare connection
Go to console settings and unconnect and reconnect to ethernet
Start remote play again

items.title: How to Fix Meter Not Reading
items.cause: Console settings, Capture Card settings, Wrong Format
items.fix:
**PlayStation**

- HDCP OFF
- Resolution 1080p
- HDR OFF
- ALLM OFF
- VRR OFF
- Deep Color Range OFF
- RGB Range Full

**Xbox**

- Resolution 1080p
- 24 Bit
- PC RGB Color Range 
- Video Modes ALL OFF
- Night Mode OFF
- High Contrast Mode OFF
- Color Blindness Filter OFF

items.title: How to Fix CVPY-0033
items.fix:
Delete Bin 
Reinstall the script you got this Error Code on

items.title: How to Fix CVPY-0032
items.fix:
Read the full Error Code if you see (An Application Control policy has blocked this file.) do this 

- Disable Anti Virus 
- Disable Smart App Control

items.title: 0xC0000005
items.fix: Go to Online Resources and Reinstall InputSense-CUDA

items.title: A plugin could not be loaded
items.fix:
- Disable Smart App Control 
- Disable Window Defender
